objects.name: workspaces_workspaces
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE workspaces_workspaces (
  id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  path           TEXT NOT NULL,
  path_key       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name           TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_opened_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: workspaces_workspaces_by_opened
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX workspaces_workspaces_by_opened ON workspaces_workspaces (last_opened_at DESC)

objects.name: attachments_files
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE attachments_files (
  sha256     TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(sha256) = 64),
  size       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: attachments_items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE attachments_items (
  id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  sha256     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attachments_files (sha256),
  name       TEXT NOT NULL,
  mime       TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('image', 'file')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: attachments_items_by_sha
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX attachments_items_by_sha ON attachments_items (sha256)

objects.name: attachments_refs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE attachments_refs (
  owner_key  TEXT NOT NULL,
  item_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attachments_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (owner_key, item_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: attachments_refs_by_item
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX attachments_refs_by_item ON attachments_refs (item_id)

objects.name: conversation_threads
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE conversation_threads (
  id                     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
  title                  TEXT NOT NULL,
  title_source           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (title_source IN ('pending', 'auto', 'user')),
  posture                TEXT NOT NULL,
  origin                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('user', 'automation')),
  session_id             TEXT,
  session_file           TEXT,
  initial_model_provider TEXT,
  initial_model_id       TEXT,
  initial_thinking       TEXT,
  forked_from            TEXT,
  pinned                 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (pinned IN (0, 1)),
  archived               INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (archived IN (0, 1)),
  created_at             INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at             INTEGER NOT NULL,
  controls_snapshot      TEXT,
  CHECK ((initial_model_provider IS NULL) = (initial_model_id IS NULL)),
  CHECK ((session_id IS NULL) = (session_file IS NULL))
)

objects.name: conversation_threads_by_workspace
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX conversation_threads_by_workspace ON conversation_threads (workspace_id, archived, pinned DESC, updated_at DESC)

objects.name: conversation_threads_by_session_file
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversation_threads_by_session_file ON conversation_threads (session_file) WHERE session_file IS NOT NULL

objects.name: conversation_submissions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE conversation_submissions (
  client_turn_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  thread_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversation_threads (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  text             TEXT NOT NULL,
  attachments      TEXT NOT NULL,
  skills           TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_as     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (requested_as IN ('turn', 'steer', 'followUp')),
  status           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'started', 'queued', 'failed')),
  turn_id          TEXT,
  error_code       TEXT,
  error_message    TEXT,
  rev              INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at       INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: conversation_submissions_by_thread
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX conversation_submissions_by_thread ON conversation_submissions (thread_id, created_at)

objects.name: conversation_submissions_by_turn
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX conversation_submissions_by_turn ON conversation_submissions (thread_id, turn_id, client_turn_id) WHERE turn_id IS NOT NULL

objects.name: conversation_reclaim
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE conversation_reclaim (
  session_file TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  thread_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempts     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_error   TEXT,
  created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at   INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: usage_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE usage_events (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  thread_id   TEXT NOT NULL,                                    -- 无外键；线程删除后保留
  day         TEXT NOT NULL,                                    -- Core 本地时区日期 YYYY-MM-DD
  at          INTEGER NOT NULL,
  provider    TEXT NOT NULL,
  model       TEXT NOT NULL,
  input       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  output      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cache_read  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cache_write INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cost        REAL NOT NULL
)

objects.name: usage_messages
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE usage_messages (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  day TEXT NOT NULL,
  at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: usage_messages_by_day
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX usage_messages_by_day ON usage_messages (day)

objects.name: usage_daily
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE usage_daily (
  day         TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider    TEXT NOT NULL,
  model       TEXT NOT NULL,
  input       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  output      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cache_read  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cache_write INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cost        REAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (day, provider, model)
) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: review_turn_files
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE review_turn_files (
  thread_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
  turn       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  path       TEXT NOT NULL,
  before     TEXT,
  after      TEXT,
  state      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('applied', 'reverted')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, turn, path)
)

objects.name: review_turn_files_by_turn
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX review_turn_files_by_turn ON review_turn_files (thread_id, turn)

objects.name: automations_automations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE automations_automations (
  id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title          TEXT NOT NULL,
  prompt         TEXT NOT NULL,
  cron           TEXT,
  time_zone      TEXT NOT NULL,
  workspace_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
  posture        TEXT NOT NULL,
  model_provider TEXT,
  model_id       TEXT,
  thinking       TEXT,
  enabled        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1)),
  next_run_at    INTEGER,
  issue          TEXT,
  created_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  run_at         INTEGER,
  thread_mode    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' CHECK (thread_mode IN ('new', 'continue')),
  thread_id      TEXT,
  notify         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'attention' CHECK (notify IN ('always', 'attention', 'never')),
  catch_up       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (catch_up IN (0, 1)),
  CHECK ((model_provider IS NULL) = (model_id IS NULL))
)

objects.name: automations_automations_due
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX automations_automations_due ON automations_automations (enabled, next_run_at) WHERE issue IS NULL

objects.name: automations_runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE automations_runs (
  id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  automation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES automations_automations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  thread_id     TEXT,
  triggered_by  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (triggered_by IN ('schedule', 'manual', 'catch_up')),
  scheduled_for INTEGER,
  started_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
  settled_at    INTEGER,
  outcome       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('running', 'awaiting', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'skipped')),
  message       TEXT,
  summary       TEXT,
  attention     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attention IN (0, 1))
)

objects.name: automations_runs_by_automation
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX automations_runs_by_automation ON automations_runs (automation_id, started_at DESC)

objects.name: automations_runs_open
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX automations_runs_open ON automations_runs (outcome) WHERE outcome IN ('running', 'awaiting')

objects.name: automations_runs_by_thread
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX automations_runs_by_thread ON automations_runs (thread_id) WHERE thread_id IS NOT NULL

objects.name: intelligent_ui_states
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE intelligent_ui_states (
  thread_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
  call_id            TEXT NOT NULL,
  title              TEXT NOT NULL,
  model_json         TEXT,
  view_json          TEXT,
  model_revision     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  delivered_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at         INTEGER NOT NULL,
  tweaks_json        TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, call_id)
)

objects.name: workbuddy_accounts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE workbuddy_accounts (
  id                   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  label                TEXT NOT NULL,
  auth_type            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (auth_type IN ('oauth', 'api')),
  access               TEXT NOT NULL,
  refresh              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  expires              INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  refresh_expires_at   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  uid                  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  domain               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  token_type           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  enterprise_id        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  api_key              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  plan                 TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  status               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ok' CHECK (status IN ('ok', 'expired', 'error')),
  status_message       TEXT,
  usage_json           TEXT,
  usage_at             INTEGER,
  last_checkin_day     TEXT,
  last_checkin_at      INTEGER,
  last_checkin_outcome TEXT,
  last_checkin_message TEXT,
  last_checkin_credit  REAL,
  last_checkin_streak  INTEGER,
  created_at           INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at           INTEGER NOT NULL
, rest_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rest_reason TEXT, last_checkin_next_try_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

objects.name: workbuddy_accounts_uid
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX workbuddy_accounts_uid ON workbuddy_accounts (uid)

objects.name: workbuddy_settings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE workbuddy_settings (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
)
